note.en: The Caribbean volute is a colourful, heavy-shelled snail of deeper sand and rubble from Honduras to Colombia. WoRMS lists it for Costa Rica but the local records are fossil beds, so it is not normally met by divers.
note.es: La voluta del Caribe es un caracol colorido y de concha pesada de fondos más profundos de arena y escombro, de Honduras a Colombia. WoRMS la registra para Costa Rica pero los registros locales son de depósitos fósiles, así que los buzos normalmente no la ven.

evidence: WoRMS lists the Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea
GBIF: 2 records in the region (Moín fossil beds)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Listed for the Costa Rican Caribbean by WoRMS; the local records are fossils (Moín).
